data.text: Case AUTH_PARTIAL. Return to Events in open mode. Keep the storm, but leave the shipwreck as a possibility; clear weather is unselected, not rejected. I accept the blue light, not the warning bell. For the compound possibility “Rúna is the sender and the murderer”, only the sender part is accepted; leave the murder undecided. Set routine checkpoints to every exchange. Summarize captured proposals, established decisions and open questions, then pause.
